name: Pipser
summary: Pipser is a semi-automated trading utility that places Buy and Sell orders via on-chart buttons. It executes market orders with a fixed lot size and configurable stop loss, but has no take profit, no strategy logic, and no automated entry signals — the trader manually decides when to click the buttons.
summary_zh: Pipser是一个半自动交易工具，通过图表上的按钮手动下单。它以固定手数和可配置止损执行市价单，但没有止盈、没有策略逻辑、没有自动入场信号——完全由交易者手动决定何时点击按钮。
strategy_analysis: Pipser本质上不是一个自动化策略EA，而是一个半手动交易辅助工具。入场条件完全依赖交易者主观判断，通过点击图表上的Buy或Sell按钮触发市价单。出场条件仅设置了止损（SL参数），且止损会根据品种的小数位数自动调整（5位/3位报价时SL扩大10倍），但没有设置任何止盈目标，盈利出场完全依赖交易者手动平仓。仓位管理方面使用固定手数（Lot参数），没有任何基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位计算。资金管理几乎不存在，没有最大持仓限制、没有账户权益保护机制、没有回撤控制。整体而言，该EA将交易决策权完全交给交易者，仅提供了便捷的下单界面和基础止损保护。
strategy_analysis_en: Pipser is fundamentally not an automated strategy EA but a semi-manual trading aid. Entry conditions rely entirely on the trader's subjective judgment, triggered by clicking Buy or Sell buttons on the chart. Exit conditions only include a stop loss (SL parameter), which auto-adjusts for 5/3-digit quote symbols by multiplying SL by 10, but there is no take profit target — profitable exits depend entirely on the trader manually closing positions. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lot parameter) with no dynamic calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management is virtually nonexistent — there are no maximum position limits, account equity protections, or drawdown controls. Overall, this EA delegates all trading decisions to the trader and only provides a convenient order execution interface with basic stop loss protection.

parameters.name: SL
parameters.description: 止损点数（5位报价时自动乘10）
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points (auto x10 for 5-digit quotes)

pros: 界面简洁直观，通过图表按钮一键下单，操作便捷
自动根据报价位数调整止损值，避免5位报价品种止损过小的问题
代码结构清晰简洁，易于理解和二次开发
pros_en: Simple and intuitive interface — one-click order placement via chart buttons
Automatically adjusts stop loss based on quote digit count, preventing undersized SL on 5-digit brokers
Clean and concise code structure, easy to understand and extend
cons: 没有任何自动策略逻辑，完全依赖人工判断，不算真正的自动化交易系统
缺少止盈设置，盈利仓位没有自动出场机制，容易因犹豫错失利润
没有持仓检查，重复点击按钮可能导致意外加仓；没有错误处理，OrderSend失败无反馈
缺少滑点过滤和点差检查，在剧烈波动时可能以极差价格成交
cons_en: No automated strategy logic whatsoever — fully manual, not a true automated trading system
No take profit setting, profitable positions have no auto-exit mechanism,容易因犹豫错失利润
No position check — repeated button clicks may cause unintended additional positions; no error handling for OrderSend failures
No spread filter or slippage protection, may fill at extremely unfavorable prices during high volatility
improvements: 添加OrderSend返回值检查和错误提示，避免交易失败时交易者毫不知情
增加持仓检查逻辑，防止重复下单导致仓位失控；添加止盈参数和可选的追踪止损功能
增加点差过滤和交易时间限制，提升执行质量
improvements_en: Add OrderSend return value checking and error notification so traders know when orders fail
Add position check logic to prevent unintended duplicate orders; add TP parameter and optional trailing stop
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to improve execution quality

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，重复点击按钮可导致意外大量加仓
没有OrderSend错误处理，交易失败无任何反馈，交易者可能误以为下单成功
没有止盈机制，盈利仓位完全依赖手动管理，存在情绪化决策风险
Slipage默认值为0，在高波动市场可能导致订单被拒
risk_points_en: No position check — repeated button clicks can cause unintended large position accumulation
No OrderSend error handling — failed trades give no feedback, trader may assume order succeeded
No take profit mechanism, profitable positions depend entirely on manual management with emotional decision risk
Slipage defaults to 0, which may cause order rejection in volatile markets

summary_en: Pipser is a semi-automated trading utility that places Buy and Sell orders via on-chart buttons. It executes market orders with a fixed lot size and configurable stop loss, but has no take profit, no strategy logic, and no automated entry signals — the trader manually decides when to click the buttons.
